card.name: Reproduction studies in pregnancy sections
card.fires_on: The word "performed" or "studies" in pregnancy-section phrases like "Reproduction studies have been performed" and "no adequate and well-controlled studies".

modes.label: Reproduction studies performed
modes.description: The word performed (or studies) in animal reproduction study statements.
modes.example: Reproduction studies have been<< performed>> in rats, rabbits, monkeys and dogs

modes.label: Well-controlled studies
modes.description: The word studies in "no adequate and well-controlled studies" in pregnant women.
modes.example: There are no adequate and well-controlled<< studies>> of ADCETRIS in pregnant women

card.writes: Promotes words about testing, verification and validation, which fits study and test language.
card.plain: It fires on the wording that says animal or human studies were done, in the pregnancy part of a label.
